Average flipper length by species (after cleaning): Adelie 190.82 mm, Chinstrap 200.13 mm, Gentoo 217.00 mm.

Data problems found and fixed:
- 1 exact duplicate row (row 61) — removed so no penguin was double-counted.
- 2 rows (8 and 58) had impossible flipper lengths (-200 and -187 mm), outside the rules-file range of 170–235 mm — excluded from the analysis rather than guessing values.

Other issues noted but not relevant to this question (left untouched): body_mass_g has one value stored as text ("3,075"), and sex has case variants (MALE/FEMALE) plus 2 missing values. Species labels were verified clean. The averages are based on 68 of 71 rows.
